name: Stage 59: Skanssundet to Viad
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 59, Skanssundet to Viad.
utilities: Skanssundet/Hörningsnäs is the dependable stage-start access cluster: official trailhead, ferry terminal, parking, SL 727 stop, and mapped public dry/portable toilets with no drinking water.

Sandviksbadet is the main early alternate/access cluster: official route variant, EU bathing beach, seasonal toilet, kiosk in bathing weather, grill/barbecue context, signed bath parking, and SL 727 stops near the road.

Hörningsnäs naturreservat/Lundstigen provides an 800 m yellow-marked local alternative to part of the gravel-road section, with information boards, small reserve access/parking, picnic/viewpoint context, and no verified water.
Viad is a trail junction rather than a service node. Stage 60 explicitly says no parking at Viad; plan pickup, continue to Stage 60, or walk out toward Näs/Eldtomta bus access.
Skansholmen services and the Skansholmen water tap are across/near the Stage 58 ferry side, useful for chained hikes but not reliable as Stage 59 on-route services.
Eldtomta has useful off-route finish-side services by bus 727: cafe, lodging, and a 24/7 food vending machine. Treat them as detour or access planning, not on-stage facilities.
waterSources: No verified potable water was found on Stage 59. Carry enough from Skansholmen/Skanssundet-side services or earlier.
Skanssundet toilets are mapped with no drinking water, Sandviksbadet has seasonal toilets/kiosk but no verified trail water tap, and coastal/brackish water should not be treated as a refill plan.
If continuing, Stage 60 has natural sources and Stora Träsket shelter after Viad, but those are beyond Stage 59 and still require treatment/filtering.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Use 9.0 km as the official planning distance. Naturkartan/Komoot-style mainline geometry measures about 9.1 km, while OSM relation 5280050 can measure about 9.45 km when the ferry is included and its metadata rounds to 10 km.

Stage 59 starts on the Hörningsnäs/Södertörn side of Skanssundet. OSM relation 5280050 includes the Skanssundet ferry from the Mörkö side for through-route continuity, but official Stage 59 should treat that ferry as an inter-stage connector rather than walked land-stage distance.
Official information listed no current Stage 59 fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. Use live Trafikverket ferry info and SL/727 planning before relying on access logistics.

The first roughly 3 km include larger/smaller road and gravel-road walking. Komoot's surface breakdown is mostly road/asphalt/gravel, and user reports plus Team Vildmark recommend considering the Sandviksbadet alternate and Lundstigen for a nicer start.

Cattle/grazing animals may be present between Näs By and Viad, including along the waterline and around gates. Keep dogs leashed, move calmly around livestock, avoid crowding animals at gates, and expect wet or awkward shoreline/pasture footing.
No official Stage 59 shelter, campsite, fireplace, toilet, or water facility was verified. Treat AllTrails camping/dog-friendly tags as generic activity metadata, not site-specific permissions.

Hörningsnäs reserve rules include no fire except at designated places, parking only in designated places, no caravans, no plant/wood removal, riding only on constructed road, and dogs leashed. Lundstigen is short and useful but not fully accessible, and no designated Stage 59 fire site was verified.

Sandviksbadet/Himmerfjärden-Sandviken is an EU bathing site with 2026 classification Bra kvalitet and a 15 May-15 September bathing season. Check live samples and algae warnings before swimming; 2026 sample dates are listed for June 9, July 7, July 21, and August 4.
The Sandviksbadet alternate is official but appears to be missing from OSM Stage 59 relation 5280050. Mainline-only imports underrepresent the official route options.

AllTrails/user reports warn that some third-party tracks may overshoot Viad or miss the Sandviksbadet alternate. Prefer official/Naturkartan/Sörmlandsleden geometry for the stage endpoint, and avoid using the implausibly high Topo GPS ascent figure.

facilities.name: Skanssundet stage 59 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 59 start on the Hörningsnäs/Södertörn side, after the Skanssundet ferry connection from Stage 58.

facilities.name: Skanssundet ferry, Hörningsnäs side
facilities.description: Free Trafikverket road ferry to Mörkö/Skansholmen, about 330 m and 3 minutes. Pedestrians/cyclists board with vehicle traffic, so use the marked pedestrian area/gate and check live ferry status before relying on it.

facilities.name: Skanssundet SL 727 stop
facilities.description: SL 727 stop/terminus near the stage start. The 2026 PDF is valid to 18 June and again from 17 August, with a summer gap requiring SL live planning; regular bikes/e-scooters generally are not accepted unless folded.

facilities.name: Skanssundet parking
facilities.description: Parking near the ferry/trailhead. Official Stage 59 lists parking nearby at the Skanssundet end.

facilities.name: Skanssundet public toilets
facilities.description: Mapped dry/portable public toilets beside the ferry/parking area. OSM tags indicate no drinking water/handwashing; verify condition seasonally.

facilities.name: Ferry/live-planning warning
facilities.description: Skanssundsleden is adjacent planning infrastructure for chained hikes. OSM Stage 59 relation includes the ferry, but the official stage starts on the Hörningsnäs side; ignore stale old closure notices unless Trafikverket's live page/app confirms a current disruption.

facilities.name: OSM ferry connector caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 5280050 includes the 330 m Skanssundet ferry from Mörkö, while the official Stage 59 start is on the north/Hörningsnäs side. Show this as a connector, not walked trail distance.

facilities.name: Early road-walking caution
facilities.description: The first roughly 3 km include road/asphalt/gravel walking with ferry-traffic pulses and rural sightlines. Walk on the left edge where appropriate, use visibility in low light, and take extra care around bends.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet alternate route
facilities.description: Official early alternate route passes Sandviksbadet, and the stage manager recommends it for a swim/rest. OSM relation 5280050 and some third-party maps miss this option; follow current markings if choosing it.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet
facilities.description: EU bathing place at Himmerfjärden/Sandviken with about 150 m sandy brackish beach, toilet, grill places, and seasonal kiosk. 2026 classification is Bra kvalitet; check live samples and avoid swimming during algal blooms.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet toilet
facilities.description: Seasonal toilet at/near Sandviksbadet bathing place during the 15 May-15 September bathing season. Kiosk/toilet service can depend on bathing weather and late-season weekends; no verified drinking-water tap was found for hikers.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet kiosk
facilities.description: Seasonal kiosk by Sandviksbadet, usually tied to bathing weather/season and reduced late-summer availability. Do not rely on it without checking current opening.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet parking
facilities.description: Signed bathing-place parking for Sandviksbadet; use only marked parking and local signs.

facilities.name: Sandviksbadet SL 727 stop
facilities.description: SL 727 stop near the road for Sandviksbadet/start-side access.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs SL 727 stop
facilities.description: SL 727 stop that can be used to skip some early asphalt/gravel-road walking, according to recent trail-page comments.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs / Lundstigen
facilities.description: Hörningsnäs nature-reserve access and yellow-marked Lundstigen, an 800 m leafy local alternative to part of the gravel-road section through hazel, aspen, old elm, oak woodland, rock outcrops, and field/Näslandsfjärden views. Not fully accessible; no verified water.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs picnic/viewpoint
facilities.description: Picnic table/viewpoint context in Hörningsnäs naturreservat near Lundstigen. Rest/view only; no water or toilet verified.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs reserve parking
facilities.description: Small designated reserve parking for Hörningsnäs/Lundstigen access. Reserve rules require parking only at designated places.

facilities.name: Hörningsnäs reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules include fires only at designated places, parking only in designated places, no caravans, no plant/wood removal, riding only on constructed road, and dogs leashed.

facilities.name: Näs SL 727 road access
facilities.description: Off-route/road-access bus stop on the finish half of the stage. Useful as a bailout but not directly at the trail endpoint.

facilities.name: Höglundsåsen viewpoint
facilities.description: Recommended official rest/viewpoint area above Sjövik with views toward Södertälje, Hallsfjärden, Brandalsunds slott and Viads gård. Approximate pin from route/review cross-checks.

facilities.name: Näs By to Viad pasture warning
facilities.description: Trail follows pasture/shoreline terrain where grazing animals may be present, sometimes right by the waterline. Keep dogs leashed, avoid crowding animals at gates, and expect wet/narrow or awkward footing.

facilities.name: Viad stage 59/60 junction
facilities.description: Stage 59 endpoint and Stage 60 start. Treat as a trail junction rather than a service node.

facilities.name: No reliable Viad parking
facilities.description: Stage 60 explicitly says no parking at Viad, and user reports note difficulty finding parking. Plan pickup, continue to Stage 60, or walk out toward Näs/Eldtomta transit.

facilities.name: Viad track-overshoot caveat
facilities.description: Some third-party Stage 59 tracks/reviews overshoot Viad by more than a kilometre or miss the Sandviksbadet alternate. Snap the endpoint to the official Stage 60 start coordinate here when building routes.

facilities.name: Viad beach, Stage 60 context
facilities.description: Small beach immediately after the Stage 60 start. Nearby context for hikers continuing beyond Stage 59; not a Stage 59 service guarantee.

facilities.name: Eldtomta SL 727 access
facilities.description: Practical finish-side bus access after an extra road walk from Viad. Trail comments describe the walkout as long/dull.

facilities.name: Eldtomta Café detour
facilities.description: Off-route finish-side cafe and crafts stop by bus 727. Opening hours vary; useful for access planning, not an on-stage service.

facilities.name: Eldtomta lodging detour
facilities.description: Off-route guest-house/apartment lodging near Eldtomta bus access. Verify availability before planning around it.

facilities.name: Eldtomta 24foodomat
facilities.description: OSM-mapped 24/7 grocery vending machine near Eldtomta bus access. Treat as off-route resupply and verify locally.

facilities.name: Stora Träsket shelter, Stage 60 context
facilities.description: Nearest proper onward shelter after Viad if continuing onto Stage 60. Included as continuation context, not a Stage 59 facility.
